## Upcoming conferences & dissemination activities

The **HYDRA-EO** project is presented and discussed at selected scientific
meetings and mission-oriented workshops. These venues are used to share
methodological advances, prototype tools, and reproducible examples
related to hybrid RTM–ML approaches, imaging spectroscopy, and EO-based
crop stress detection.

---

::: {.vbl-card}

- **[ESA Digital Twin Earth Components – Open Science Meeting 2026](https://nikal.eventsair.com/esa-digital-twin-earth-components-open-science-meeting-2026/)**  
  *2–5 February 2026 · ESA-ESRIN, Frascati, Italy*  
  ESA open science meeting dedicated to **Digital Twin Earth** components,
  mission-oriented methods, Cal/Val readiness, and multi-sensor
  integration for Earth Observation workflows.

- **[FLEX-Fluorescence 2026 Workshop](https://flex-fluorescence-workshop-2026.esa.int/)**  
  *3–6 March 2026 · Bonn, Germany*  
  International ESA workshop focused on the latest developments in
  fluorescence remote sensing, including updates on the
  **Fluorescence Explorer (FLEX) – Sentinel-3 tandem mission**.

- **[14th EARSeL Workshop on Imaging Spectroscopy](https://is.earsel.org/workshop/14-IS-Helsinki2026/)**  
  *2–4 June 2026 · Helsinki, Finland*  
  International scientific workshop on imaging spectroscopy, covering
  methods, sensors, applications, and reproducible workflows across
  environmental and agricultural monitoring.

:::
